preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 2 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S must be lowercase English alphabet characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of distinct strings obtained after performing exactly one swap.
